_note: Text copy for the SledPack concept film (SIM-033). Edit wording/numbers here and re-render the overlay only (sim/tools/render_promo.py --overlay-only). Numbers must come from research/sledpack_2026_10_21/dev/promo_facts.json / results.json and stay marked as simulated. Anything that FAILS in simulation must not be claimed.

tag.zh: 概念可视化 · 仿真渲染 · 未经实物验证
tag.en: Concept visualisation · simulated render · not physically tested

sub.zh: 住在背包里的跟拍风筝 · 概念
sub.en: A follow-cam kite that lives in your pack · concept

title.zh: 没有杆子。只是一个背包。

sub.zh: 风筝收在贴着脊柱的套管里，腰下是一个漏斗口
sub.en: The kite rides in a sleeve along your spine; a funnel mouth sits at the base

title.en: Everything powered stays in the pack

reel.zh: 双卷轴：主线 + 泄力线
reel.en: Two-drum reel: main line + depower line

folded.zh: 折叠软翼风筝 + 相机吊舱

title.zh: 设计目标：蹬出去，它就知道
title.en: Designed to know when you push off

sub.zh: 惯导 + 卫星定位判定滑行；缆车、排队、上坡时锁定（仿真设想，未实测）
sub.en: IMU + GNSS to confirm you are skiing; lift, queue and uphill lockouts (simulated concept, not tested)

note.zh: 示意界面 · 数值为剧本示意

title.zh: 设计设想：气流把它拉出来
title.en: Concept: the airflow pulls it out

sub.zh: 估计相对风 ≥5.5 m/s 才放飞，顺风超过约 6 m/s 不放飞；先泄力低空拖出约 3 m，再张开爬升。出套与张开过程未建模、未实测
sub.en: Only above ≈5.5 m/s apparent wind and not in tailwinds above ≈6 m/s; it streams low and depowered to ≈3 m, then opens and climbs. Sleeve extraction and opening are not modelled or tested

sub.zh: 无动力软翼风筝，约 6 m 线长，仰角约 55°
sub.en: An unpowered soft kite on about 6 m of line, at about 55°

label.zh: 机载视角 · 仿真渲染，非实拍
label.en: Onboard view · simulated render, not real footage

sub.zh: 吊舱相机顺着线看向你
sub.en: The pod camera looks down the line at you

mainMid.zh: 主线：卷轴管线长与松紧
mainMid.en: Main line: the reel manages length and slack

depMid.zh: 泄力线：调迎角，控制拉力
depMid.en: Depower line: trims angle of attack to hold the pull

kite.zh: 风筝上没有电机、没有螺旋桨
kite.en: No motor, no propeller on the kite

pack.zh: 电机与传感器都在背包里
pack.en: Motors and sensors live in the pack

sub.zh: 风筝泄力成低垂拖伞，边滑边收线（顶风/侧风时贴雪面回来；顺风停下时仿真中绳曾经过头部 0.4 m 以内，待解决）
sub.en: The kite depowers into a low drogue and reels in while you slide (low over the snow in head/cross wind; in tailwind stops the simulated line passed within 0.4 m of the head — unresolved)

title.zh: 设计目标：自己回到背上（入套成功率为假设模型）
title.en: Designed to dock itself (capture success is an assumed model)

sub.zh: 吊舱从下方进入套管口，翼杆并拢滑入，触点接通充电
sub.en: The pod enters the mouth from below, the spars fold together, contacts mate and it charges

title.zh: 缆车、排队、走路：全部收好

sub.zh: 没有外露的杆，线全部收回（腰下有一个漏斗口）
sub.en: No pole sticking out, line fully reeled in (a funnel mouth sits at the base)

title.zh: 仿真中达标的项目与设计估算
title.en: Passing in simulation, plus design estimates

label.zh: 全套背负质量（设计估算）
风筝 + 吊舱（设计估算，含 48 MP 模组）
label.en: Kite + pod (design estimate, incl. 48 MP module)

label.zh: 对身体的最大拉力（限值 40 N）
label.en: Peak pull on the body (limit 40 N)

label.zh: 最大撞击动能（限值 14.9 J，余量很小；15–17 m/s 高手速度时超限）
label.en: Peak strike energy (limit 14.9 J; thin margin, fails for 15–17 m/s riders)

footnote.zh: 数值来自未经标定的数值仿真（48 种风况、一种中级滑雪者速度），不是实测；部分子模型为假设。
footnote.en: Numbers from uncalibrated numerical simulation (48 wind cases, one intermediate rider profile), not measurements; some sub-models are assumed.

items.zh: 线与风筝到头部的净距：仿真最小 0.40 m（顺风停下时），规则要求 ≥1 m —— 安全问题，未解决
items.en: Line/kite clearance to the head: 0.40 m minimum in simulation (tailwind stops); the rule asks ≥1 m — an unresolved safety issue

items.zh: 可用画面占比：仿真约 43%，目标 ≥80%；顺风时约 22%，顺风超过约 6 m/s 不放飞
items.en: Usable footage: ≈43% in simulation vs a ≥80% target; ≈22% in tailwinds, no flight above ≈6 m/s tailwind
Jitter: ≈6.4 °/s in simulation vs a ≤3 °/s target

items.zh: 观察方位不可选：风筝不可转向（可指令跨度 0°，目标 ≥45°）
items.en: Viewing angle cannot be chosen: the kite is not steerable (0° commandable vs a ≥45° target)

items.zh: 约 45% 的时间绳低悬在骑手身后（对他人有绊倒风险）
items.en: For ≈45% of the time the line runs low behind the rider (trip hazard to others)

items.zh: 首次入套 97.8%（假设捕获模型），产品目标 ≥98%
items.en: First-try dock 97.8% (assumed capture model) vs a ≥98% product target

items.zh: 三线（主线、泄力线、尾线）从同一出口有缠绕风险，未仿真
items.en: Main, depower and tail lines share one mouth and can twist — not simulated

items.zh: 尚未做任何实物与雪场试验
items.en: No physical or on-snow tests yet

sub.zh: 设计目标：背着走，滑起来就飞，停下就回家
sub.en: The goal: wear it, ski, and it flies; stop, and it comes home.

disclaimer.zh: 概念设计。本片全部画面为计算机仿真渲染，不是实拍；性能数字来自未经标定的仿真，尚未进行任何实物试验。13 项判定指标中仿真达标 8 项，尚不是可用设计。
disclaimer.en: Concept design. Every frame is a computer-simulated render, not real footage. Performance numbers come from uncalibrated simulation; no physical tests have been run. It meets 8 of 13 criteria in simulation and is not yet a usable design.

_numbers_source: research/sledpack_2026_10_21/dev/promo_facts.json FINAL I9 (after independent review) + review/report.json copyAudit. Facts block = criteria passing in simulation plus labelled design estimates; failing items, assumed models, no-margin passes and safety issues are under 'Still open'.
